groups.title: Data Integration
points: Designed and implemented end-to-end Talend ETL pipelines and RESTful APIs enabling seamless data integration across multiple enterprise systems such as Salesforce (e-commerce), ORLI (warehouse management), and the Azure data platform.

Partnered with stakeholders to translate functional requirements into scalable data transformation logic, and authored comprehensive technical documentation, including system architecture, data flows, and deployment/recovery plans.

groups.title: Cloud & Security Operations
points: Managed and secured Azure resources by implementing IAM policies, SSL, and IP restrictions to maintain an organised and secure cloud environment.
Optimised Azure resource utilisation through automated scheduling scripts, saving €1,400 per month while maintaining system reliability.

groups.title: Observability
points: Deployed a real-time Datadog monitoring solution with custom dashboards and alerts, significantly reducing the Mean Time to Detection (MTTD) and enhancing observability and reliability across ETL pipelines.

Implemented a fault-tolerant asynchronous integration using MuleSoft API-led architecture to connect Salesforce Service Cloud and the Diduenjoy feedback platform, ensuring reliable data delivery through robust error handling.
Chose an asynchronous design so a slow or unavailable downstream platform could never block the service desk, with explicit error handling to guarantee eventual delivery.
Implemented a real-time C++ signal processing Savitzky-Golay filter to reduce infrared data noise, achieving a 100× speedup in preprocessing for metal classification.
Developed and trained a Random Forest classifier for accurate metal classification, enabling near-instantaneous analysis.
